title: Local console: same-origin CORS, one write-guard middleware, tenant path validation
description:
Problem: any web page the operator visits can read and mutate the local board. kbsc configures CorsLayer with allow_origin(Any), allow_methods(Any), allow_headers(Any) and allow_private_network(true) (rust/src/bin/console_local.rs:320-326). The only write protection is require_loopback (:678-688), which a browser on the same machine satisfies, so a page can POST status changes and comments to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/issues/<id>/status and read the responses. Only about 6 of 14 mutating routes call require_loopback at all: wiki create, update, delete and rename (:1600-1737), notifications (:1290-1298) and telemetry (:1215-1230) have no guard, so with CONSOLE_HOST=0.0.0.0 (what dev.sh defaults to) anyone on the LAN can edit wiki files in the repo and push ui_control events to every connected console. In multi-tenant mode resolve_tenant_root joins :account and :project into a path without validation (rust/src/console_backend.rs:49-51), so a percent-encoded ../ escapes CONSOLE_DATA_ROOT. Also: kbsc appends repo paths to a fixed world-readable /tmp/kbsc_trace.txt on every start (:98-110), and error_response echoes raw error strings including filesystem paths and maps every write failure to 400 (:811, 844, 884, 1906-1909).

Work:
1. Restrict allow_origin to the console's own origin(s) plus CONSOLE_DEV_ORIGIN when set; drop allow_private_network.
2. Require a custom request header (for example X-Kanbus-Console: 1) on every non-GET route so a cross-origin request fails preflight, and validate Origin/Host against the bound address.
3. Replace the per-handler require_loopback calls with one axum middleware layer applied to all mutating routes.
4. Validate account and project segments against ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ in resolve_tenant_root and canonicalise plus starts_with(base) as serve_asset_from_filesystem already does. Python console mirrors get the same checks.
5. Gate the /tmp trace behind an env var or remove it; map KanbusError variants to proper status codes (NotFound 404, InvalidTransition 409 or 422, Io 500) with generic bodies.
6. Decide the bind-host story once (loopback by default, explicit opt-in for LAN with a token) and make dev.sh, the code comment at :674 and resolve_bind_host agree.

Acceptance: a cross-origin fetch from a test page to a mutating route is refused; every non-GET route is covered by the middleware (add a test that enumerates routes); ..%2F in a tenant segment returns 400; existing console cucumber scenarios pass.
